findings.description: If get_error_message(error_code) returns NULL, passing it to printf with %s causes undefined behavior and can crash.
Only printing the error without stopping or cleaning up means the program may continue in an invalid state after clEnqueueNDRangeKernel fails.
Printing errors to stdout can leak details to unintended sinks. Prefer stderr and avoid verbose details in production.
clEnqueueNDRangeKernel reads work_dim elements from global_work_size/local_work_size. If the arrays have fewer than work_dim elements, the OpenCL runtime will read past the provided buffers.
